name: How do you choose the right baseboard height for a room?

mainEntity.name: How do you choose the right baseboard height for a room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Baseboard height should correspond directly with your room's ceiling height and architectural style. For standard eight-foot ceilings, baseboards typically measure between three and five inches high to avoid making the room look compressed. For nine- or ten-foot ceilings commonly found in modern or renovated homes, profiles between five and eight inches provide appropriate visual balance. Choosing a profile that is too narrow under high ceilings can look underwhelming, while overly tall moldings under low ceilings make the space feel shorter.
acceptedAnswer.description: Match baseboard height to your ceiling height: standard eight-foot ceilings usually take 3- to 5-inch trim, while nine-foot or higher ceilings look best with 5- to 8-inch profiles.
